macro_cross_check.verdict: FAIL as computed - flagged, not silently fixed
macro_cross_check.detail: This is the loudest thing in the batch. 4 lb of wings for 4 servings is a pound of wings per person, and applying the Perdue label (210 cal, 20 g protein per 112 g raw) to the full as-purchased 1814 g gives 864 cal and 81 g protein per serving: 80% over the source's published 45 g protein and well past this run's 650 cal ceiling. The cause is a basis mismatch, not a portion error: the gram weight is bone-in as purchased (right for cost), while every wing macro figure is a meat-and-skin basis. Applying the standard whole-wing edible yield of about 64% gives 545 cal and 52 g protein per serving, which brackets the source's 620/45 from either side. I did NOT shave the grams to make the macros land, because the cost side needs the purchased weight - someone downstream has to decide the yield basis for bone-in poultry, and this recipe's band eligibility turns entirely on it. Separately, the source's published 20 g carbs cannot be reproduced from these 8 lines (ours is 2.5 g); the source most likely counted a dipping sauce that is not in the ingredient list.
